# Assets · IconsV2

37 files under `assets/IconsV2/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for actionable_disabled_new_icon.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

The newer SABIC icon set: navigation (Home, map), KPI colour icons (plants, affiliates, system, CO₂ reduction, energy production, active / overdue deviations), arrows and angle brackets (gray and blue variants), star / badge / brain / eye / help / reset, chart and table view toggles, predicted-action icons. Prefer these over older duplicates. productionGain_color_icon.png is a 128px PNG render (its SVG embedded a raster).
